title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Building Amounts Already Sworn on the Claim
content:
Claim file practice on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): what counts as the building amount already sworn on a claim when a further building proof of loss is sworn on it.

**Rule.** The building amount already sworn on the claim is worked out as follows: when the claim carries building proofs of loss and the latest of them was received no later than the proof-of-loss period after the date of loss, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, the amounts sworn on them are added together; when the claim carries no building proof of loss whose latest was received within that period but building payments were issued on the claim on the adjuster's report signed in lieu of a proof of loss, the building payment items voided on the claim are subtracted from the building payments issued on it; otherwise nothing is already sworn on the claim.

The proof-of-loss period is 60 calendar days on every tier.

## Input — judgement — output

| Claim file shows | Already sworn on the claim |
|---|---|
| Building proofs of loss, the latest received on or before day 60 after the date of loss | the total of the amounts sworn on all of them |
| Building proofs of loss, the latest received after day 60; building payments issued on the claim | building payments issued less building payment items voided |
| No building proof of loss; building payments issued on the adjuster's report signed in lieu | building payments issued less building payment items voided |
| No building proof of loss within the period and no building payments standing | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and amounts; date of loss 1 August)

- Proofs of loss of 40,000.00 and 15,000.00, the latest received 30 September (day 60): 55,000.00 is already sworn.
- One proof of loss of 40,000.00 received 1 October (day 61), building payments of 30,000.00 issued with one 5,000.00 item voided: 25,000.00 is already sworn.
- No proof of loss and no building payment: nothing is already sworn.
